messages.content: build simple calculator using html , css , javascript

Explain this code: ``` Simple Calculator
```

Is HTML code ka clear explanation niche step-by-step diya gaya hai:

### 1. Document Setup (`<head>`)
* **`<!DOCTYPE html>` & `<html lang="en">`**: Ye browser ko batata hai ki ye HTML5 document hai.
* **`<meta charset="UTF-8">`**: Special characters aur symbols ko correctly render karne ke liye UTF-8 encoding set karta hai.
* **`<meta name="viewport" ...>`**: Responsive design ke liye hai, taaki app mobile aur desktop dono par sahi fit dikhe.
* **`<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">`**: Calculator ko style karne ke liye external `style.css` file ko connect karta hai.

---

### 2. Main Container & Screen (`<body>`)
* **`<div class="calculator">`**: Ye pure calculator UI ka main outer box (container) hai.
* **`<input type="text" class="calculator-screen" id="screen" disabled />`**:
  * Ye calculator ki screen/display hai jaha numbers aur calculation dikhte hain.
  * `disabled` attribute user ko directly keyboard se type karne se rokta hai, taaki UI buttons ya handled JS events se hi value update ho.
  * `id="screen"` JavaScript me is element ko select karne ke liye use hota hai.

---

### 3. Keypad & Buttons (`<div class="calculator-keys">`)
Ye section grid layout banata hai jisme saare buttons wrap hain. Har button par JavaScript `onclick` functions attached hain:

* **Clear & Delete Buttons**:
  * `onclick="clearScreen()"`: Screen ko bilkul empty karne ke liye ("C" button).
  * `onclick="deleteLast()"`: Last entered digit ko remove karne ke liye ("DEL" button).

* **Number & Operator Buttons**:
  * `onclick="appendValue('...')"`: Jab bhi user number (0-9) ya operator (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `.`) press karta hai, ye function us character ko screen ke andar end me add kar deta hai.
  * `÷` (`÷`) aur `×` (`×`): HTML entity codes hain multiplication aur division signs ko render karne ke liye.

* **Equal Button**:
  * `class="equal-sign"`: CSS grid me is button ko bada (span 2 rows) dikhane ke liye specific styling.
  * `onclick="calculateResult()"`: JavaScript me likhi calculation logic execute karta hai.

---

### 4. JavaScript Connection
* **`<script src="script.js"></script>`**: Page ke end me External JavaScript file attach karta hai jisme logic (`appendValue`, `calculateResult`, etc.) likha gaya hai.
